name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
description: Financial support of ₹6,000 per year to landholding farmer families in three equal installments.

name: National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
description: Monthly financial assistance for widows living below the poverty line.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension (IGNOAPS)
description: Monthly pension for elderly citizens aged 60 and above living below the poverty line.

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension (IGNDPS)
description: Financial assistance for individuals with severe and multiple disabilities belonging to BPL families.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: Financial assistance for the construction of pucca houses for rural poor and houseless households.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
description: Housing assistance and interest subsidies for urban poor, EWS, and LIG categories.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
description: Health insurance cover of up to ₹5 Lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
description: Provides deposit-free LPG connections to women belonging to below-poverty-line households.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
description: Guarantees 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer for unskilled manual work.

name: PM SVANidhi Scheme
description: Micro-credit facility providing affordable working capital loans to street vendors.

name: PMMY Mudra Loan Scheme
description: Collateral-free institutional loans up to ₹10 Lakhs for micro and small enterprise non-corporate business units.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
description: Bank loans between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹1 Crore for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs for greenfield enterprises.

name: National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS)
description: One-time financial assistance of ₹20,000 to a bereaved family upon the death of its primary breadwinner.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
description: Accidental insurance scheme offering coverage for accidental death and disability at a nominal premium.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
description: Renewable one-year life insurance scheme covering death due to any cause.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Guaranteed minimum pension scheme ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month for unorganized sector workers.

name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
description: Old age protection and monthly pension of ₹3,000 for unorganized workers after age 60.

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
description: Financial support and industry apprenticeship training opportunities for youth.

name: PM-DAKSH Yojana
description: Skill development training programs for target groups including SC, OBC, Economically Backward Classes, and Sanitation Workers.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
description: National mission for financial inclusion providing zero-balance bank accounts with RuPay debit cards and overdraft facilities.

name: NSFDC Concessional Loan Scheme
description: Concessional financial assistance for income-generating activities for persons belonging to Scheduled Castes.

name: NSTFDC Financial Assistance
description: Concessional loans for economic development projects for Scheduled Tribes.

name: NMDFC Term Loan Scheme
description: Low-interest financial assistance for self-employment ventures for backward sections among minorities.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
description: Timely and adequate credit support to farmers for cultivation and other agricultural needs at subsidized interest rates.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Crop insurance scheme providing financial protection against crop failure due to natural calamities.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Provides crop-wise recommendations of nutrients and fertilizers to help farmers improve productivity.

name: PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)
description: Water-focused scheme enhancing physical access to water on farms ('Har Khet ko Paani' and 'More Crop per Drop').

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
description: Financial support and infrastructure development for sustainable fisheries and fish farmers.

name: Rashtriya Gokul Mission
description: Development and conservation of indigenous bovine breeds and support for dairy farmers.

name: PM-KUSUM Scheme
description: Installation of solar pumps and grid-connected solar power plants for farmers to ensure irrigation security.

name: e-NAM Agricultural Trading Portal
description: Pan-India electronic trading portal networking agricultural produce markets for transparent pricing.

name: PM POSHAN Abhiyaan (Mid-Day Meal)
description: Nutritional hot cooked meals provided to school children in government and aided primary/upper-primary schools.

name: Samagra Shiksha Abhiyaan
description: Inclusive education program providing free textbooks, uniforms, and infrastructure support up to senior secondary level.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMSS)
description: Scholarship awards to meritorious students from economically weaker sections to prevent dropouts at class VIII.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students
description: Financial assistance covering tuition fees and maintenance allowances for post-matriculation studies.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
description: Educational financial support for students belonging to Other Backward Classes for higher education.

name: Vidya Lakshmi Education Loan Scheme
description: Portal for students to view, apply, and track education loans across multiple banks seamlessly.

name: National Mission for Empowerment of Women
description: Holistic support, legal assistance, and empowerment programs for women across rural and urban settings.

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao Scheme
description: Campaign generating awareness around girl child education, welfare, and prevention of gender-biased elimination.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Account Scheme
description: Small deposit savings scheme for girl children offering high tax-free interest rates for higher education and marriage.

name: Mission Vatsalya (Child Protection)
description: Protective care, financial sponsorship, and rehabilitation services for children in difficult circumstances.

name: POSHAN Abhiyaan (National Nutrition Mission)
description: Reduces malnutrition and stunting among young children, pregnant women, and lactating mothers.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: Direct cash transfer of ₹5,000 to pregnant women and lactating mothers for their first live birth to compensate for wage loss.

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
description: Safe motherhood intervention under the National Health Mission promoting institutional delivery among poor pregnant women.

name: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP)
description: Umbrella social security scheme providing financial aid to elderly, widows, and disabled persons.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram (PMJVK)
description: Socio-economic infrastructure development projects (schools, hospitals, skill centers) in minority-concentrated areas.

name: Tamil Nadu Destitute Widow Pension Scheme
description: State monthly financial assistance of ₹1,200+ for destitute widows residing in Tamil Nadu.

name: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister's Old Age Pension Scheme
description: Monthly social security pension for indigent senior citizens aged 60 and above in Tamil Nadu.

name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme (Pudhumai Penn)
description: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000 directly credited to girl students studying in higher education who studied in government schools from classes 6 to 12 in Tamil Nadu.

name: TN Free Electricity Supply for Farmers
description: Free electricity connection and supply for agricultural pump sets across farming lands in Tamil Nadu.
